name: llms.txt
summary: Proposal to standardize a /llms.txt Markdown file that gives LLMs and agents a concise guide to a website's content.
description: v2 of the proposal (page modified 10 Aug 2026) allows llms.txt at any subpath (e.g. /docs/llms.txt covers /docs/, most specific file wins), accepts both markdown URL forms (page.html.md or page.md), and recommends rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" and rel="describedby" links (in HTML or a Link header) so clients can find the markdown and the covering llms.txt.
